The Burundi coalition developed a shadow report together with other civil society organisations. Out of 15 SRHR-related recommendations proposed by the Right Here Right Now coalition and its partners, 11 were put forward by member states. One of the recommendations asked for the revision of Ordinance 60/1078 in order to encourage pregnant girls to attend school for as long as they wish and to ensure their reintegration, which was accepted by the Burundi government.
